text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text: Whoa...! <nickname>, your running is like night and day compared to before.

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text:
That's my Trainer, just as I'd expect!
Awhahaha!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The proprietress praised our training session!
She seems to hold us in very high regard!
